import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Ensure the data types are correct
assert df['Vintage'].dtype == 'int64', "Vintage column should be of type int64"
assert df['Preqin Median Net IRR'].dtype == 'float64', "Preqin Median Net IRR column should be of type float64"

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df['Vintage'], df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], marker='o')
plt.title('Trend of Preqin Median Net IRR Over Vintage Years')
plt.xlabel('Vintage Year')
plt.ylabel('Preqin Median Net IRR')
plt.xticks(df['Vintage'])  # Ensure all years are shown on the x-axis
plt.grid(True)
# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Vintage', 'y_fields': ['Preqin Median Net IRR'], 'chart_type': 'lineChart'}
plt.show()
